concepts.title: Mean of Grouped Data - Direct Method
concepts.formula: mean = sum(f_i * x_i) / sum(f_i), where x_i is the class mark and f_i is the frequency of the i-th class.

concepts.title: Mean of Grouped Data - Assumed Mean Method
concepts.formula: mean = a + sum(f_i * d_i) / sum(f_i), where a is the assumed mean and d_i = x_i - a.

concepts.title: Mean of Grouped Data - Step Deviation Method
concepts.formula: mean = a + h * sum(f_i * u_i) / sum(f_i), where u_i = (x_i - a) / h and h is the class width.

concepts.title: Mode of Grouped Data
concepts.formula: mode = l + ((f1 - f0) / (2*f1 - f0 - f2)) * h, where l is the lower limit of the modal class, f1 is the frequency of the modal class, f0 is the frequency of the class preceding the modal class, f2 is the frequency of the class succeeding the modal class, and h is the class width.

concepts.title: Median of Grouped Data
concepts.formula: median = l + ((N/2 - cf) / f) * h, where l is the lower limit of the median class, N is the total frequency, cf is the cumulative frequency of the class preceding the median class, f is the frequency of the median class, and h is the class width.

concepts.title: Cumulative Frequency Curve (Ogive)
concepts.formula: Less than ogive: plot points (upper limit, cumulative frequency). More than ogive: plot points (lower limit, cumulative frequency). Median = x-coordinate of intersection of the two ogives.

concepts.title: Relation Between Mean, Median, and Mode
concepts.formula: 3 * median = mode + 2 * mean, equivalently mode = 3 * median - 2 * mean, or mean = (3 * median - mode) / 2.
